failure.line: Don't confront me with my failures
stanza: Well, I'll keep on moving
Moving on
Things are bound to be improving
These days
One of these days
These days I'll sit on cornerstones
And count the time in quarter tones to ten
My friend
Don't confront me with my failures
I had not forgotten them

failure.linePrev: Left there to burn in their arrogance
failure.line: But as for me I'm coming to my final failure
failure.lineNext: Killed myself with changes trying to make things better
stanza: But as for me I'm coming to my final failure
Killed myself with changes trying to make things better
Ended up becoming something other than what I had planned to be
Now I believe that lovers should be draped in flowers
And laid entwined together on a bed of clover
And left there to sleep
Left there to dream of their happiness

failure.line: We need a record of our failures
failure.lineNext: Yes, we must document our love
stanza: So Michael, please keep the tape rolling
Boys, keep strumming those guitars
We need a record of our failures
Yes, we must document our love
I've sat too long in my silence
Have grown too old in my pain
To shed this skin, be born again
It starts with an ending

partner.line: Have grown too old in my pain

failure.line: She knows there's no success like failure
